About us  

 Our client is conveniently located in Sydney's inner west in a diverse and family friendly environment. Established for over 30 years, they are recognized as medical leaders in the community and would welcome a new team member to help support our patients.

Their health precinct includes onsite Pathology collecting service, Psychologists, Podiatrists, Dentists and Physiotherapists We are AGPAL accredited and offer RACGP registrar training positions. They are area a mixed billing practice, with private billing for skin, cosmetic and minor procedures.

 Generous Remuneration

 Medical Director software
